description: Change one row of the Household and personal items list: its name, value or recipient, remove it, or move it to its own asset (track_separately). Item ids come from get_asset_detail on the household list asset or get_estate_summary. Removing only takes it off the list. Edits one row of the Household and personal items list. remove takes it off the list (it is kept as removed, not deleted); track_separately turns it into its own asset, which may start task preparation on eligible paid estates.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

recipient.description: Who is receiving it (empty string clears).

remove.description: true to take it off the list (the customer said it's gone, a duplicate, or not the decedent's).

track_separately.description: true to move it to its own asset with its own tasks, when the customer asks (e.g. it needs an appraisal).

name: update_household_item
